verdict.rationale: The evidence documents real-time sync, reactive queries, and WebSocket-based live updates of persisted database data. Nothing documents a presence-tracking feature or a mechanism for broadcasting ephemeral, non-persisted state between connected clients. Reactive sync is a developer building block from which presence could be built, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track user presence and broadcast ephemeral state between connected clients
